blocks.text: Domain code uses controller / service / repository folders under lib/features/<domain>/, same as lib/features/leads in core. Legacy lib/controllers paths are thin re-exports.
Lead and PromoBanner live in packages/core/prisma/schema.prisma. Overlay schemas contain only domain models. Sync merges them into the generated template schema.
